subject: Question : Is it possible to combine Open HDS and Hierarchical Community Distance Sampling?

messages.author: 93e2d4587d90a376
messages.subject: Question : Is it possible to combine Open HDS and Hierarchical Community Distance Sampling?
parts:
Dear all,

I want to pick up your brain to figure out how to model open hierarchical community distance sampling models.

Main question
Is it possible to model hierarchical community distance sampling while accounting for temporary emigration? Could you point me in the right direction of where to look (has any study do this before?) for an example code? I am quite new to hierarchical model, and I doubt I could develop this model from scratch on my own.

Why these models?
I want to account for spatial temporary emigration while understanding the ecological patterns shaping the spatial variation in species abundance. I expect that the covariates I will use would affect the different species in a similar way, as these species belong to the same family and have similar physiological, behavioural, and distributional patterns. The reason for integrating Open HDS and HCDS is that some species are very common while others are rare. I believe (please correct me if I am wrong) that by using HCDS, I could incorporate rare species that otherwise could not be model independently as the data is scarce.

How does the data look like?
  • Sites: 23-30
  • Species: 6
  • Visits per site: 7-11 (over two years - only dry season) 
Similar approaches to what I want to do but not quite the same:
  • AHM1 - section 9.5
  • Sollman et al. 2016, Methods in Ecology and Evolution
  • Goyert et al. 2016, Ecological Applications
  • Sollman et al 2015, Ecology
  • Yamaura et al. 2012 Biodivers. Conserv.
Thank you very much for your time if you have read this far.

All the best,

Alejandro
